clustering: game-cluster bootstrap for every CI; walk-forward by date with a 5-6 date burn-in; no random row splits.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Taker order-flow imbalance over the last 30/60 min predicts the direction of the next fair-mid move and yields positive executable CLV on the flow side.
hypotheses.status: SUPPORTED (price discovery): BH survivor in 5 families, fair-mid +0.04..+0.28c on flow side; post-fee taker P/L NEGATIVE in every cell

hypotheses.hypothesis: Momentum: a >=2c (30m) / >=3c (60m) mid move continues into the close (vs. reverses).
hypotheses.status: REJECTED as continuation: 30/60-min moves REVERSE (game_total, inning_result), BH survivors on the reversal side

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reversal: the same moves partially revert before first pitch (overreaction).
hypotheses.status: SUPPORTED (price discovery): F5 ML reversal +0.7..+5.8c in all 12 variants; post-fee P/L not significant (best +2.19 [-0.44,+4.59])

hypotheses.hypothesis: Last trade printing above (below) mid signals buying (selling) pressure that continues.
hypotheses.status: SUPPORTED (price discovery): +0.12..+0.19c; post-fee NEGATIVE

hypotheses.hypothesis: Quotes unchanged for >=60 min are stale and drift on the next update; direction unknown a priori (both sides registered).
hypotheses.status: WEAK: +0.09c toward YES on game_result after 60 stale minutes; post-fee NEGATIVE

hypotheses.hypothesis: Wide spreads (>=6c) precede adverse executable CLV on either side (execution cost dominates).
hypotheses.status: not a BH survivor on P/L; wide spreads -> negative both sides (descriptive)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Open-interest surges over 60 min mark informed positioning; direction registered both ways.
hypotheses.status: MIXED: OI surge -> YES side +0.13c on winning_margin only; post-fee ~0

hypotheses.hypothesis: A walk-forward ridge over all predeclared microstructure features predicts fairMidMoveToClose out-of-sample (feature-discovery tool, not a strategy).
hypotheses.status: walk-forward ridge: OOS corr 0.31 on inning_result (dir. acc. 0.61 when market moved), ~0 elsewhere; net P/L on signalled rows not > 0

hypotheses.hypothesis: Top-of-book size imbalance and depth predict the next move and bound fillability.
hypotheses.status: PROSPECTIVE_ONLY_HYPOTHESIS

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lead/lag: Pinnacle's move over the prior 15 min predicts Kalshi's move over the next 15 min more than Kalshi's own past move does.
hypotheses.status: NO DETECTABLE PINNACLE->KALSHI LEAD AT 15-MINUTE RESOLUTION IN A 2-DATE PILOT (corr 0.05, 1,206 rows, 20 games). This is INCONCLUSIVE, not a refutation: the remaining hypothesis is that an exploitable lead lives on a SHORTER timescale, which 15-minute snapshots cannot see. Status stays PROSPECTIVE_ONLY.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Kalshi-vs-Pinnacle disagreement predicts Kalshi's subsequent fair-mid move toward Pinnacle (+30/+60/close).
hypotheses.status: drift toward Pinnacle slope 0.12-0.28 per pp, every CI includes 0 at 20 games -- underpowered, not negative

hypotheses.hypothesis: Buying Pinnacle's side when |disagreement| >= 3pp earns positive executable CLV after fees.
hypotheses.status: INSUFFICIENT: |disagreement| >= 3pp too rare at 15-minute resolution (mean 0.50pp); says nothing about shorter horizons

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pinnacle probability adds settlement information beyond Kalshi's price.
hypotheses.status: INSUFFICIENT at pilot size

hypotheses.hypothesis: Same as D1-D3 on totals ladders with exactly matching x.5 lines.
hypotheses.status: 0 exactly-matching x.5 lines on the two pilot dates -- a coverage gap, not a result

hypotheses.hypothesis: Number of books moving the same direction (DK/FD/BetMGM/Pinnacle) predicts Kalshi's next move.
hypotheses.status: RUN: 315 rows / 103 games / 18 dates; |Pinnacle-Kalshi| 0.61pp, |consensus-Kalshi| 0.58pp; every disagreement/move cell INSUFFICIENT (<15 games)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Production team-total probability adds information after conditioning on Kalshi's price.
hypotheses.status: REJECTED: dLogLoss 1.5e-5 (CI -3e-5..7e-5); fair-mid moves AWAY from model side -0.30c (CI -0.53..-0.07); exec CLV on model side -0.84c (CI -1.14..-0.57), 72 OOS games

hypotheses.hypothesis: Same for game_result/F5/totals/strikeouts/outs.
hypotheses.status: INSUFFICIENT (<= 8 dates of evaluations per family)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Kalshi reprices ML/F5 with a measurable lag after lineup confirmation; an executable window exists.
hypotheses.status: HISTORICAL BOUND: no measurable effect (event 0.51c vs control 0.62c, 82 games, 181-min windows); PROSPECTIVE_ONLY

hypotheses.hypothesis: Starter scratch/opener announcement -> F5 total/ML repricing lag.
hypotheses.status: PROSPECTIVE_ONLY_HYPOTHESIS

hypotheses.hypothesis: Wind/forecast revisions move totals ladders with a lag.
hypotheses.status: PROSPECTIVE_ONLY_HYPOTHESIS

hypotheses.hypothesis: Total-ladder implied distribution shape (skew/steepness) predicts team-total or F5-total movement.
hypotheses.status: REJECTED on F5/full ratio: signal-side fair-mid -0.19c [-0.28,-0.07] (wrong direction) or CI incl. 0; post-fee negative

hypotheses.hypothesis: F5 vs full-game implied scoring relationship deviations predict which side moves.
hypotheses.status: same test as T-LADDER (F5/full expected-total ratio): no predictive shape signal

multipleTesting: BH-FDR q=0.10 across all coarse-rule tests within Family C; every registered hypothesis is reported, winners and losers.
scientificWordingCorrection: An earlier session summary said the sharp-lag story had 'nowhere to hide'. That overstated a 2-date, 15-minute pilot. The supported claim is only: NO DETECTABLE PINNACLE->KALSHI LAG AT 15-MINUTE RESOLUTION IN A 2-DATE PILOT. MLB-ALPHA-0002-D01-SHARPLAG is retained as PROSPECTIVE_ONLY / HISTORICAL-PILOT-INCONCLUSIVE.
